description: This file contains an abstract class defining a cache resource handler for key/value stores in the Smarty template engine. It implements cache invalidation, read/write operations, and lock management for hierarchical cache groups, designed to work with external storage like memcache or APC.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_KeyValueStore
classes.description: An abstract class providing key/value cache handling with invalidation and locking for the Smarty template engine, designed to interface with external caching systems like memcache or APC.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates cache metadata including filepath and timestamp info for a cached template object.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populates timestamp and existence info of a cached template object from cache storage.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads cached content, evaluates it, and manages cache content availability.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes rendered template output into cache with associated metadata.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Reads cached template content from cache storage.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears entire cache storage, either by purge or invalidation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific template identified by resource, cache id, and compile id.

methods.name: getTemplateUid
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for a template resource, typically its UID or filepath.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes components of cache identifiers to ensure safe storage keys.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches cache content and timestamp for a given cache identifier.

methods.name: addMetaTimestamp
methods.description: Adds current microtime as a header to cached content.

methods.name: getMetaTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts timestamp from cached content header.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Marks cache entries as invalidated based on invalidation keys.

methods.name: getLatestInvalidationTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the latest invalidation timestamp for a cache entry considering invalidation hierarchy.

methods.name: listInvalidationKeys
methods.description: Generates a list of invalidation keys based on cache identifier components.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Checks if the cache for a template is currently locked.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock on the cache for a template.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the cache for a template.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Abstract method to read cache entries; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Abstract method to write cache entries; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Abstract method to delete cache entries; must be implemented in subclasses.
